description: 1 MILE FROM NOTRE DAME---Great area of homes --ALL BRICK ranch with a large 2-car attached garage. Upon entering this home from the front covered porch is the living room with refinished hardwood floors, and down the hall are 3 bedrooms which have hardwood under the carpet, and 2 full baths. The kitchen is awesome with stainless steel Whirlpool appliances and a lot of custom cabinets, and a large island with cabinets below.  You will enjoy the 9' x 11' dining area which has a hardwood floor that can handle a large dining table. On the east end of the kitchen is an alcove that has the door to the backyard, and has built-in cabinets which could be removed  and use the space for a Stackable washer/dryer unit as it is located above the plumbing used for the current W/D in the lower level. This home has had a lot of recent updates. There are two finished rooms in the lower level and  another room that can be finished to be used as an all-purpose room or one can remove a wall to extend the family room. Updates in this home  include---2023--Hardwood floors were refinished, Electric was updated and new fixtures installed,  the home interior was painted on the main floor and in the lower level, new Luxury vinyl flooring installed in the lower level family room and den/study, Pest inspection was completed, and all passed. 2022--Tear off roof installed, gutter extensions added. 2020--new inground sprinkling system installed. 2016--vinyl clad replacement windows installed, and a new garage overhead door was installed. This home can be a great Notre Dame week-end rental or a perfect place to just "call home" Must see inside to appreciate
